Bill.BriefDescription: Complying with the constitutional requirement to set a starting time for regular legislative sessions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to compliance with Article II, section 12 of thestate Constitution; amending RCW 44.04.010; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that in November 1979the voters approved the establishment of annual regular sessions of thelegislature. The approved amendment to Article II, section 12 of thestate Constitution provides that the legislature shall convene on suchday and at such time as the legislature shall determine by statute.The legislature has provided a day for convening by statute, the secondMonday of January each year, but rather than provide a time forconvening such session by statute, the legislature has relied on customand joint legislative rules to set the time as 12:00 p.m. Since theConstitution specifically directs that the time as well as the day forconvening regular sessions shall be determined by statute, it is thepurpose of this act to add to the statute a regular session startingtime of 12:00 p.m.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 44.04.010 and 1980 c 87 s 27 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Regular sessions of the legislature shall be held annually,commencing at 12:00 p.m. on the second Monday of January.
